name: GlorySEO
author: aumsrini

sections.description:
GlorySEO helps you improve search engine visibility by enabling SEO features for all your content. Manage meta tags, schema markup, Open Graph and Twitter cards, 301 redirects, 404 logs, and product SEO.

Features

  • Focus Keyword + SEO Score
  • Meta Title and Description fields
  • Open Graph + Twitter Card meta
  • JSON-LD Schema (Article + Product)
  • Redirect Manager (301/302)
  • 404 Error Log Viewer
  • WooCommerce SEO
  • Bulk Meta Editor
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/gloryseo
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Visit GlorySEO settings to begin configuration
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release of GlorySEO with all core features.
